factory_reset.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#config-action) triggers a factory reset of the Zigbee device. It handles leaving the Zigbee network.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID to use for this `zigbee` component.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

ieee802154_vendor_oui.docs:
**int**: Sets the Vendor Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI). This allows replacing Nordic Semiconductor's default company ID with your own. The value must be a 24-bit integer in the range `0x000000` to `0xFFFFFF`. Alternatively, set to `random` to generate a new random OUI on every firmware compilation. This is useful during development to force the coordinator (ZHA/Z2M) to recognize the device as new after firmware updates.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

model.docs:
**string**: Model Identifier of the Zigbee device. Defaults to the ESPHome node name.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

on_join.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations#automation)**: Automation to run when the device joins the network. In [Lambdas](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda) you can get the join type with `x`. It is `true` for join and `false` for rejoin.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

on_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations#automation)**: Automation to run when the Zigbee stack is fully initialized and can be interacted with. It will then try to (re-)join a network.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

power_source.docs:
**enum**: Indicates what kind of power the device uses. Affects sleep behavior. One of `UNKNOWN`, `MAINS_SINGLE_PHASE`, `MAINS_THREE_PHASE`, `BATTERY`, `DC_SOURCE`, `EMERGENCY_MAINS_CONST`, or `EMERGENCY_MAINS_TRANSF`. Defaults to `DC_SOURCE`.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

router.docs:
**boolean**: If true the Zigbee role will be `router` instead of `end device` and it will forward Zigbee packets from other devices. Routers drain more power than end devices and need to be always on for a stable Zigbee network. For this reasons battery-powered devices should not be used as routers. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

sleepy.docs:
**boolean**: Disable RX during idle to reduce power consumption for battery-powered devices. It may cause stability problems with the Zigbee connection. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Zigbee Component](https://esphome.io/components/zigbee#configuration-variables)*

once.docs: Erase data only on first boot after flashing new firmware, then preserve.
